title: Multi-omics insights into anti-colitis benefits of the synbiotic and postbiotic derived from wheat bran arabinoxylan and Limosilactobacillus reuteri.
authors: Zhou, Lanqi; Song, Wei; Liu, Tianqi; Yan, Tao; He, Ziyan; He, Weitai; Lv, Jiayao; Zhang, Shiyi; Dai, Xiaoshuang; Yuan, Li; Shi, Lin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究麦麸阿拉伯木聚糖与罗伊氏乳杆菌的合生元/后生元通过调节色氨酸代谢和AhR信号缓解结肠炎，仅用分子对接验证代谢物与靶点结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Exploring nutritional therapies that manipulate tryptophan metabolism to activate AhR signaling represents a promising approach for mitigating chronic colitis. Arabinoxylan is a bioactive constituent abundant in wheat bran. Here, we comprehensively investigated anti-colitis potentials of wheat bran arabinoxylan (WBAX), its synbiotic and postbiotic derived from WBAX and Limosilactobacillus reuteri WX-94 (i.e., a probiotic strain exhibiting tryptophan metabolic activity). WBAX fueled L. reuteri and promoted microbial conversion of tryptophan to AhR ligands during in vitro fermentation in the culture medium and in the fecal microbiota from type 2 diabetes. The WBAX postbiotic outperformed WBAX and its synbiotic in augmenting efficacy of tryptophan in restoring DSS-disturbed serum immune markers, colonic tight junction proteins and gene profiles involved in amino acid metabolism and FoxO signaling. The WBAX postbiotic remodeled gut microbiota and superiorly enhanced AhR ligands (i.e., indole metabolites and bile acids), alongside with elevation in colonic AhR and IL-22. Associations between genera and metabolites modified by the postbiotic and colitis in human were verified and strong binding capacities between metabolites and colitis-related targets were demonstrated by molecular docking. Our study advances the novel perspective of WBAX in manipulating tryptophan metabolism and anti-colitis potentials of WBAX postbiotic via promoting gut microbiota-dependent AhR signaling.
abstract_zh: 探索利用色氨酸代谢调控AhR信号通路的营养疗法，是缓解慢性结肠炎的一种有前景的策略。阿拉伯木聚糖（Arabinoxylan）是麦麸中含量丰富的生物活性成分。本研究全面评估了麦麸阿拉伯木聚糖（WBAX）及其合生元和后生元（源自WBAX和具有色氨酸代谢活性的益生菌菌株罗伊氏乳杆菌WX-94）的抗结肠炎潜力。在体外发酵过程中，WBAX促进了罗伊氏乳杆菌的生长，并推动了微生物将色氨酸转化为AhR配体，这一现象在培养基和2型糖尿病粪便微生物群中均得到验证。在增强色氨酸恢复DSS干扰的血清免疫标志物、结肠紧密连接蛋白以及涉及氨基酸代谢和FoxO信号通路的基因谱方面，WBAX后生元优于WBAX及其合生元。WBAX后生元重塑了肠道微生物群，并显著提升了AhR配体（即吲哚代谢物和胆汁酸）的水平，同时伴随结肠AhR和IL-22的升高。通过分子对接，验证了后生元修饰的属和代谢物与人类结肠炎之间的关联，并展示了代谢物与结肠炎相关靶点之间的强结合能力。本研究推进了WBAX在调控色氨酸代谢方面的新视角，并揭示了WBAX后生元通过促进肠道微生物依赖性AhR信号通路发挥抗结肠炎潜力的机制。
